what: predictions of the sharp satellites' passes, sealed before each pass from MODIS rows alone, then scored
rows_note: near real time rows (FIRMS NRT, with RT and URT rows in the United States and Canada), not the science-quality archive

protocol.name: live 1: VIIRS passes predicted from MODIS near real time rows and sealed before the pass

states.scored: scored against the rows of the pass
states.not_scored: could not be scored; the reason is given

before_cycles_were_recorded.note: before cycles_recorded_from_utc no cycle was written down: the runner's starts are known from its log, not when it stopped, so whether it ran between them is not on record; draw that stretch as not recorded

runner.how_to_draw: a stop is a stretch when the sealer was not running: draw it as such; no seal in it says nothing about fire

bootstrap.improvement: method minus baseline for higher-is-better scores, baseline minus method otherwise

running_count.how_judged: over the fires: fires resampled whole 2000 times, a score ahead when the 90 percent interval of its improvement over each baseline lies above zero, behind when below zero against either, tied otherwise; pooled and per fire: strictly better than both baselines, no allowance for noise (docs/method.md)
